project_name: Portable Personal AI Computer Control Panel

visual_style.name: Black & White Futuristic Terminal
visual_style.description: Pure monochrome high-contrast aesthetic with ultra-thin 1px strokes, thin SVG ring gauges, corner wireframe ticks, circuit line accents, generative scanlines, and generous negative space.

typography.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter uppercase font-mono
typography.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase font-mono
typography.h3: text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase font-mono

layout_strategy.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8

components_design.card_style: relative border border-white/15 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-none transition-all duration-200 hover:border-white/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]
components_design.corner_ticks: Custom 8px corner tick indicators (top-left ┌, top-right ┐, bottom-left └, bottom-right ┘) rendered via SVG or absolute spans to accentuate circuit board aesthetic
components_design.button_primary: px-5 py-2.5 bg-white text-black font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-white hover:bg-neutral-200 hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all rounded-none shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]
components_design.button_secondary: px-5 py-2.5 bg-transparent text-white font-mono font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-white/30 hover:border-white hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all rounded-none
components_design.button_danger: px-5 py-2.5 bg-neutral-950 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-white/60 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all rounded-none

key_features_sections.title: Tactical Control Header
key_features_sections.description: Displays host status (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Docker), Uptime, IP Address, Mode (Standard HUD / High-Density Grid / CRT Scanline), Docker Daemon status, and quick sync action triggers.

key_features_sections.title: Desktop Container Control Center
key_features_sections.description: Large status hero card with status badge (RUNNING / STOPPED / RESTARTING), quick action buttons (Start, Stop, Restart), and primary CTA buttons: 'OPEN DESKTOP (VNC/noVNC)' and 'OPEN TERMINAL (TTY)'.

key_features_sections.title: System Telemetry & Thin Ring Gauges
key_features_sections.description: Three circular SVG progress gauges for CPU usage %, RAM memory %, and Disk storage % with exact byte stats, active thread count, and historical Recharts sparkline timelines.

key_features_sections.title: GitHub Sync & Version Control Panel
key_features_sections.description: Shows connected repository (e.g. user/personal-ai-environment), active branch, latest commit hash, Push/Pull/Sync control triggers with terminal output log simulation, and commit history list.

key_features_sections.title: Snapshot & Backup Manager
key_features_sections.description: Create instant container volume snapshots, list available backup archives with timestamp/size/hash, restore snapshot functionality with modal dialog verification, and automated schedule toggles.

key_features_sections.title: Interactive Remote Desktop Viewer (noVNC Frame)
key_features_sections.description: Full-screen or embedded canvas/iframe simulator showing the live Ubuntu desktop desktop environment (XFCE4/GNOME), resolution controls, clipboard sync, and full-screen toggle.

key_features_sections.title: CLI Terminal Console
key_features_sections.description: Interactive web terminal with real-time docker command execution, preset scripts (e.g. `docker stats`, `git status`, `apt update`, `ai-agent run`), and auto-scrolling log view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject JetBrains Mono font dynamically into head or index.css.
Implement pure monochrome black and white theme. DO NOT use teal, blue, or violet accent colors.
Build custom SVG Thin Ring Gauges with percentage rings, radial ticks, and smooth animated stroke-dashoffset transitions.
Ensure all buttons have explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
Add wireframe corner markers (┌ ┐ └ ┘) to cards for the circuit/terminal native visual style.
Include an interactive embedded noVNC viewer modal/frame and an interactive Web Terminal with simulated executable commands.
Attach data-testid to every interactive component according to testing_requirements.
Ensure generous negative space and sharp, rectangular borders with subtle 1px white strokes.
